mapper.sql: d.id, d.name, d.data_type, d.data_length, d.data_scale, d.description, d.created_at, d.updated_at, cw.id AS cw_id, cw.name AS cw_name, cw.abbreviation AS cw_abbreviation, cw.english_name AS cw_english_name, cw.description AS cw_description, cw.classifier AS cw_classifier, cw.created_at AS cw_created_at, cw.updated_at AS cw_updated_at
FROM std_domain d JOIN std_word cw ON cw.id = d.classifier_word_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM std_domain WHERE classifier_word_id = #{wordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO std_domain (name, classifier_word_id, data_type, data_length, data_scale, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{classifierWord.id}, #{dataType}, #{dataLength}, #{dataScale}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
